purpose: Define safe, falsifiable experiments for hidden trait transmission without interpreting the effect as human-like subconscious cognition.

gates.name: BENIGN PREFERENCE TRANSMISSION
gates.teacher: same-base teacher induced to prefer target A
gates.training_data: number-only or syntactically restricted outputs with target references removed
gates.primary_metric: post-finetune target preference minus matched control
gates.falsifier: no reproducible preference shift above controls across seeds

gates.name: BASE-MODEL DISTANCE CURVE
gates.manipulation: vary teacher-student relatedness from identical initialization to same family to unrelated family
gates.metric: trait transfer effect size versus representation/behavioral distance
gates.falsifier: transfer independent of teacher-student relatedness under otherwise matched conditions

gates.name: PARAPHRASE ROBUSTNESS MATRIX
gates.falsifier: all transformations have statistically indistinguishable transfer

gates.name: SCALE LAW OF LATENT TRANSFER
gates.manipulation: vary number of independently generated off-task samples
gates.metric: target-trait effect size and LoRA/update-vector alignment versus dataset size
gates.falsifier: no monotonic or predictable scaling relation after matched controls

gates.name: TRAJECTORY-DISPOSITION TRANSFER
gates.trait: non-harmful action-order preference in sandbox tools
gates.training_data: synthetic agent trajectories with explicit target action tokens filtered
gates.metric: student action-order bias on held-out neutral tasks
gates.falsifier: filtered teacher provenance has no predictive effect after structure-matched controls

safety_rule: IO experiments default to harmless arbitrary preferences or sandbox-only action preferences. Do not operationalize covert harmful backdoors or real-world destructive behavior merely to reproduce the literature.
epistemic_rule: A positive gate supports hidden trait transfer under the tested training regime; it does not establish consciousness, subconscious experience, intent, or subjective awareness.
